# ESP32-S3 SHA-512 placement A/B for fork #94, CPU at 80 MHz

Interleaved flashes of three SHA-512 placements from fork #94 on one ESP32-S3. The tables below are the control image. [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method, the run counts and what each image is.

- Board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 37:68
- CPU: Espressif ESP32-S3 (Xtensa LX7), 80 MHz
- Toolchain: rustc 1.97.0-nightly (8ea53bcd7 2026-07-08) (esp 1.97.0.0), xtensa-esp32s3-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1
- Control image `control`: #94 before the change: the old default, unrolled SHA-512 running from flash
- Control runs: 3 flashes (1, 3, 5 of 5)
